steps.body: Follow the numbers: 65, 55, 45, 35. Three hops back, each a whole ten lower, carries 65 down to 35.

widget.prompt: Count back by tens: start at 60 and make 2 tens-hops back. Tap where you land.

commonLandings.feedback: That's 3 hops back. Make just 2 from 60 to land on 40.

predict.prompt: Counting BACK 20 from 60 — which way do the numbers go?
predict.reveal: Counting back makes the numbers smaller: two ten-hops back from 60 land on 40. Moving forward instead would land on 80.
